item.description: June 1st is the first day of meteorological summer. item.title: On Cigarettes
item.description: My father’s shirts always had chest pockets. Inside, he’d keep a lighter, a pack of Marlboro Reds, and occasionally a stubby carpenter pencil poorly sharpened by a dull Milwaukee razor blade. For Valentine’s Day, or Christmas, or his birthday, my mother would buy him a pack or a carton, depending on how lean our finances were at the time. He was always a Marlboro man. item.title: Introducing The Studio
item.description: Turns out, if you don’t pay your ghost.io subscription payment for a few months, they will quite literally delete your blog and all the writing within it. Nifty little feature they got there. So, now my blog lives here. This is better anyway. Now I have full control of a website, because I’m building it, and God knows I needed another distraction from writing my book.
